name: chiptronic-travelops
description: Chiptronic TravelOps — controle de viagens corporativas (Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2)

scripts.db:local:all: npm run db:local && npm run db:local:members && npm run db:local:roles && npm run db:local:responsible
scripts.db:local:reset: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$dirs=@('.wrangler\\state\\v3\\d1','.wrangler\\state\\v3'); foreach($d in $dirs){if(Test-Path $d){Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $d -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}}; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; if(Test-Path '.wrangler\\state\\v3\\d1'){Write-Host 'AVISO: ainda nao foi possivel apagar. Pare o wrangler dev (Ctrl+C), depois use: Get-Process node,wrangler,workerd | Stop-Process -Force' -ForegroundColor Yellow; exit 1}; Write-Host 'Banco local apagado.' -ForegroundColor Green" && npm run db:local:all
scripts.db:remote:all: npm run db:remote && npm run db:remote:members && npm run db:remote:roles && npm run db:remote:responsible
